title: Impersonate feature and its per-chat schema fields undocumented
reality: chat.schema.ts carries a full Impersonate surface: impersonate, impersonatePromptTemplate, impersonateConnectionId, impersonatePresetId, impersonateBlockAgents. v2.4.0 refined Impersonate with server-backed prompt templates shared across browsers, read-only built-in previews, full-view editing, and a direct link to Quick Replies settings. The references mention 'Impersonate' only incidentally (inside the CYOA bullet); there is no Impersonate section anywhere.
fix: Add an Impersonate subsection to references/architecture.md covering the per-chat fields, the server-backed (cross-browser) templates, and impersonateBlockAgents — the last is architecturally notable because it means an impersonated turn can deliberately bypass the agent pipeline.

title: generationGuide / generationGuideSource fields undocumented
reality: chat.schema.ts defines generationGuide and generationGuideSource as per-chat fields. No reference file mentions either.
fix: Identify the surface these back (the Push Story / guided-generation path is the likely owner given narrativeDirectorMode sits alongside them) and document in references/architecture.md. Worth confirming against the client before writing, rather than inferring from the field name.

title: narrativeDirectorMode is per-chat state — corroborates the Push Story finding
reality: chat.schema.ts stores narrativeDirectorMode on the chat, which is the persistence behind v2.3.5's relocation of the Natural/Random choice onto the Push Story button (the chosen mode arms the NEXT response). Independent source-side confirmation of the agents-lane pass-A finding.
fix: When documenting the Push Story change in references/agents.md, note that the armed mode is per-chat state (narrativeDirectorMode), not a global agent setting — that is precisely why the old global Narrative Director control was removed.

title: daySummaries and continueAddsNewline undocumented
reality: chat.schema.ts carries daySummaries (per-chat day-level summary structure, distinct from the Chat Summary feature the references do cover) and continueAddsNewline (whether /continue inserts a newline).
fix: Add both to the chat-object field notes in references/architecture.md. daySummaries matters most — it is a third summary-shaped concept beyond Chat Summary and Memory Recall, and the references currently imply only two exist.

title: Version-bearing file set verified against versioning.mjs — SKILL.md table is correct
reality: scripts/versioning.mjs syncs exactly 10 paths: root package.json (canonical) plus packages/{client,server,shared}/package.json, packages/client/public/manifest.json, packages/shared/src/constants/defaults.ts, win/installer/installer.nsi, win/installer/install.bat, android/app/build.gradle, and README.md. SKILL.md's 10-row table matches; CONTRIBUTING.md's prose table lists only 8. The skill's note flagging that discrepancy is accurate.
fix: No change needed. Recorded so a later pass does not 'correct' the skill's 10-file table down to CONTRIBUTING's 8.
